name: Number of Enterprises
description: Number of Enterprises refers to the total estimated count of unincorporated non-agricultural business establishments operating within the country during the survey period.

name: Type of Ownership
description: Type of Ownership describes the legal and structural arrangement governing who owns and controls an informal business. It excludes corporate entities (companies registered under the Companies Act), cooperatives, and public sector/government undertakings.

name: Workers
description: Worker is defined as any individual engaged in the economic and entrepreneurial activities of the enterprise, serving in any capacity on either a full-time or part-time basis.

name: Emolument (in Rs.) per hired worker
description: Emolument (in Rs.) per hired worker refers to the average annual total compensation paid by an enterprise to a single hired worker for their services.

name: Gross Value Added (in Rs.) per Worker
description: Gross Value Added (GVA) per Worker is a core economic indicator that measures labor productivity within the informal, unincorporated sector. It represents the average economic value generated by a single worker (whether paid or unpaid) over the course of a year, after subtracting the cost of all inputs used up in production.

name: Gross Value Added (in Rs.) per Enterprise
description: Gross Value Added (GVA) per Enterprise is a key economic metric that measures the average annual financial contribution made by a single business entity to the country's Gross Domestic Product (GDP). It represents the net wealth generated by an individual enterprise over one year after accounting for its direct operational expenses.
